command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.SaveFormulaCategoryInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Creates/Updates a Formula Category Information record.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.SaveFormulaInfoList
command.description: (For internal use only) Creates/Update a list of Formula Information records.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.SaveMasterRecipeInfoList
command.description: (For internal use only) Creates/Updates a list of Master Recipe Information records.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.DeleteFormulaCategoryInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Deletes a Formula Category Info record.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.DeleteFormulaInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Deletes an existing Formula Info record.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.DeleteMasterRecipeInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Deletes an existing Master Recipe Info record.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.SetMasterRecipeParameterInfoToMasterRecipeInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Creates/Updates the Master Recipe Header Parameter information record given an existing Master Recipe information record.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.SetFormulaParameterinfoToFormulaInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Creates/Updates the Formula Header Parameter information record given an existing Formula information record.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.RemoveMasterRecipeParameterInfoFromMasterRecipeInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Removes the Master Recipe Header Parameter information record given an existing Master Recipe information record.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.RemoveFormulaParameterInfoFromFormulaInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Removes the Formula Header Parameter information record given an existing Master Recipe information record.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadAllFormulaCategory
command.description: Retrieves the list of all Formula Categories. The command may trace the following errors/warnings: * -10108: no Master Recipe has been found in the specified PCell.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadAllFormulas
command.description: Retrieves the list of all Formulas. You can filter the results by formula status.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadAllFormulasForFormulaCategory
command.description: Retrieves the list of all Formulas, optionally filtered by a specific Formula Category and a specific Status.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadAllFormulasForMasterRecipe
command.description: Retrieves the list of all Formulas, optionally filtered by specific Master Recipe, Status and Product Name.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadMasterRecipeList
command.description: Retrieves the list of all Master Recipes, optionally filtered by specific Name and Version, a specific Status and a specific Product Name.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadAllMasterRecipeForFormulaCategory
command.description: Retrieves the list of all Master Recipes, optionally filtered by a specific Name and Version, a specific Product Name, a specific Status and a specific Formula Category.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadAllMasterRecipeForFormula
command.description: Retrieves the list of all Master Recipes, optionally filtered by specific Name and Version, Status, Product Name and Formula.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadMasterRecipeHeaderParameters
command.description: Retrieves the list of all Header Parameters for a specific Master Recipe. The command may trace the following errors/warnings: * -10103: The specified Master Recipe does not exist in the specified PCell; * -10105: an error occurred while retrieving the Parameters for the specified Master Recipe in the specified PCell.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadFormulaHeaderParameters
command.description: Retrieves the list of all Header Parameters for a specific Formula. The command may trace the following errors/warnings: * -10102: the specified Formula has not been found in the specified PCell; * -10106: an error occurred while retrieving the Parameters for the specified Formula in the specified PCell.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.AddFormulaInfoListToMasterRecipeInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Adds a list of Formula information records to a selected Master Recipe information record.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.RemoveFormulaInfoListFromMasterRecipeInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Removes a list of Formulainformation records from the selected Master Recipe information record.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.InitReadingModel
command.description: Triggers the Reading Model initialization. You could use this command to re-populate the database consequently to a connection failure.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.UpdateFormulaInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Updates a Formula information record with any of the following details: Name, Version, Current Status.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.UpdateMasterRecipeInfo
command.description: (For internal use only) Updates a Master Recipe information record with any of the following details: Name, Version, Current Status.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadAllMasterRecipeFormulaAndCategory
command.description: Reads all master recipe, together with the associated Formulas and Formula Categories. The command may trace the following errors/warnings: * -10108: no Master Recipe has been found in the specified PCell; * -10109: no Formula has been found for the specified Master Recipe and PCell.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadMasterRecipeHeaderParametersMinimal
command.description: Retrieves the MES relevant information of all Header Parameter for a specified Master Recipe with a specified Version.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.ReadFormulaHeaderParametersMinimal
command.description: Retrieves the MES relevant information of all Header Parameter for a specified Formula with a specified Version. The command may trace the following errors/warnings: * -10100: generic error.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.CleanReadingModel
command.description: Removes all the information of the Master Recipes and the related Formulas.

commandAction.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.MasterData.Read_Chn.MSModel.Commands.CleanReadingModelOnInitHandlerShell
commandAction.description: Deletes the old instances of both Master Recipe Info and Formula Info entities, when a new request for initialization is sent out.
